# Enhanced file explorer tree

Enhanced file explorer tree adds faint horizontal and vertical lines to the file explorer so folders and the files under them are visually connected. The recorded description says it adapts to light and dark modes while keeping the original minimalist look of Obsidian.

![Enhanced file explorer tree screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lennzone/enhanced-file-explorer-tree/HEAD/thumbnail.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Enhanced file explorer tree"
    author: "lennzone"
    repo:   "lennzone/enhanced-file-explorer-tree"
    slug:   "enhanced-file-explorer-tree"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/enhanced-file-explorer-tree"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/lennzone/enhanced-file-explorer-tree"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lennzone/enhanced-file-explorer-tree/HEAD/thumbnail.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Make folder structure clearer in the file explorer by adding faint horizontal and vertical lines that visually connect folders and their files. Adapt seamlessly to light and dark modes while keeping Obsidian's original minimalist look."
}
```
